description: Oscilloscope that draws every channel of one polyphonic cable as its own coloured trace

params.text: Scales the traces vertically in powers of two, -2 to 2, so 0 draws them at size and 1 draws them twice as tall
Spaces the traces apart vertically, 0 to 3, with all sixteen drawn on top of each other at 0
Sets the span of time drawn across the display, halving with each step from about 8 seconds to about 8ms
Moves every trace up or down the display, -16 to 16

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable drawn; each channel gets its own trace and colour

notes: clicking the blank strip below and between the SPREAD and SHIFT knobs makes the traces sweep apart and back on their own, with the SPREAD knob ignored; clicking there again stops it
nothing is drawn until a cable is patched into the input; each channel of it gets a trace.
menu: Colour Schemes — the set of sixteen trace colours: Classic, Constant V, Constant L, Full Circle, Synthwave or User
Load colour scheme — reads a JSON file of colours from disk and makes it the User scheme; until one is loaded the User scheme draws every trace white
